verdict.rationale: Authenticator stores account backups in the cloud, so data residency is a fair question for this product. The evidence only shows that users pick which Microsoft personal account or iCloud holds the backup, and that location sharing is used for access checks. Neither of these lets users choose a storage region or residency, so this is adjacent at most.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
